text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT  :-(English) 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 28-32 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The note specifies the hardness (28-32 HRC) but does not state at which stage of manufacture the heat treatment applies (e.g., before or after final machining). Without this, the manufacturer cannot sequence operations correctly, risking distortion of finished features or inability to machine hardened material. The designer should add a process stage such as 'after rough machining' or 'before final grinding'.","recommended_correction":"Update N3 to specify when the toughening is performed relative to machining and surface treatment."}]}
